in_marathi.name: Rutesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of rain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rutesh is the name of the Hindu deity responsible for rain and water. He is an important god in the Hindu pantheon and is often depicted carrying a pot of water or a watering can.

in_bengali.name: Rutesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of rain
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rutesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rutesh is the name of the Hindu deity responsible for rain and water. He is an important god in the Hindu pantheon and is often depicted carrying a pot of water or a watering can.
